source: AASHTO Manual for Bridge Element Inspection (MBEI), 2nd ed., 2019 - element/defect numbers and names; condition-state (CS) phrases paraphrased and abbreviated (<= 120 chars). CS1 = no defect / sound.

defects.name: Corrosion
defects.cs2: Freckled rust; corrosion of the steel has initiated.
defects.cs3: Section loss is evident or pack rust is present; does not warrant a structural review.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Connection
defects.cs2: Loose fasteners or pack rust present; no distortion or section loss at the connection.
defects.cs3: Missing bolts, rivets or fasteners, broken welds, or pack rust with distortion; no structural review needed.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Delamination/Spall/Patched Area
defects.cs2: Delaminated; spall 1 in. or less deep or 6 in. or less in diameter; patched area that is sound.
defects.cs3: Spall more than 1 in. deep or more than 6 in. in diameter; patched area unsound or showing distress.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Exposed Rebar
defects.cs2: Present without measurable section loss.
defects.cs3: Present with measurable section loss; does not warrant a structural review.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Exposed Prestressing
defects.cs2: Prestressing strand exposed, no section loss, no visible corrosion.
defects.cs3: Exposed strand has corrosion or section loss; no strand is broken.
defects.cs4: A prestressing strand is broken, or a review found strength affected.

defects.name: Cracking (PSC)
defects.cs2: Unsealed moderate-width cracks (0.004-0.009 in.) or unsealed moderate pattern (map) cracking.
defects.cs3: Wide cracks (over 0.009 in.) or heavy pattern (map) cracking.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Efflorescence/Rust Staining
defects.cs2: Surface white without build-up, or leaching without rust staining.
defects.cs3: Heavy build-up with rust staining.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Cracking (RC and Other)
defects.cs2: Unsealed moderate-width cracks (0.012-0.05 in.) or unsealed moderate pattern (map) cracking.
defects.cs3: Wide cracks (over 0.05 in.) or heavy pattern (map) cracking.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Abrasion/Wear (PSC/RC)
defects.cs2: Coarse aggregate is exposed but still secure in the cement matrix.
defects.cs3: Coarse aggregate is loose or has popped out of the concrete matrix due to abrasion.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Distortion
defects.cs2: Distortion not requiring mitigation, or mitigated distortion.
defects.cs3: Distortion requiring mitigation that has not been addressed; does not warrant a structural review.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Movement
defects.cs2: Minor restriction of movement.
defects.cs3: Restricted movement; does not warrant a structural review.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Alignment
defects.cs2: Tolerable lateral or vertical alignment that is inconsistent with the temperature.
defects.cs3: Approaching the limits of lateral or vertical alignment; does not warrant a structural review.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Bulging, Splitting or Tearing
defects.cs2: Bulging less than 15% of the bearing thickness.
defects.cs3: Bulging 15% or more of the thickness, splitting or tearing, or bearing surfaces not parallel.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Loss of Bearing Area
defects.cs2: Less than 10% of the bearing area lost.
defects.cs3: 10% or more of the bearing area lost; does not warrant a structural review.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Leakage
defects.cs2: Minimal; minor dripping through the joint.
defects.cs3: Moderate; more than a drip and less than a free flow of water.
defects.cs4: Free flow of water through the joint.

defects.name: Seal Adhesion
defects.cs2: Adhered for more than 50% of the joint height.
defects.cs3: Adhered for 50% or less of the joint height, but some adhesion remains.
defects.cs4: Complete loss of adhesion.

defects.name: Seal Damage
defects.cs2: Seal abrasion without punctures.
defects.cs3: Punctured, ripped or partially pulled out.
defects.cs4: Punctured completely through, pulled out or missing.

defects.name: Seal Cracking
defects.cs2: Cracks on the seal surface only.
defects.cs3: Cracks extend partway through the seal depth.
defects.cs4: Cracks extend through the full depth of the seal.

defects.name: Debris Impaction
defects.cs2: Partially filled with hard-packed material, but still allowing free movement.
defects.cs3: Completely filled and impacts joint movement.
defects.cs4: Completely filled and prevents joint movement.

defects.name: Adjacent Deck or Header
defects.cs2: Edge delamination or spall 1 in. or less deep or 6 in. or less in diameter; no exposed rebar.
defects.cs3: Spall over 1 in. deep or 6 in. in diameter, exposed rebar, or an unsound patch that loosens the joint.
defects.cs4: Spall, delamination, unsound patch or loose anchors that keep the joint from functioning.

defects.name: Metal Deterioration or Damage
defects.cs2: Metal joint component shows surface corrosion without section loss.
defects.cs3: Section loss, cracking or minor damage to the metal joint component.
defects.cs4: Broken or missing metal component, or damage affecting traffic or the seal.

defects.name: Delamination/Spall/Patched Area/Pothole (Wearing Surfaces)
defects.cs2: Wearing surface delaminated, spalled or patched; less than 10 pct of the surface.
defects.cs3: 10 pct or more of the wearing surface delaminated, spalled, patched or potholed.
defects.cs4: Wearing surface loss warrants a structural or safety review.

defects.name: Crack (Wearing Surface)
defects.cs2: Unsealed moderate cracking in the wearing surface, or sealed cracking of any width.
defects.cs3: Unsealed wide cracking or pattern cracking in the wearing surface.
defects.cs4: Cracking warrants a structural or safety review.

defects.name: Settlement
defects.cs2: Exists within tolerable limits, or arrested with no observed structural distress.
defects.cs3: Exceeds tolerable limits; does not warrant a structural review.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Scour
defects.cs2: Exists within tolerable limits, or arrested with effective countermeasures.
defects.cs3: Exceeds tolerable limits but is less than the critical limits of the scour evaluation.
defects.cs4: Warrants a structural or scour review, or a review found strength or serviceability affected.

defects.name: Damage
defects.cs2: Impact damage; the resulting defect is recorded in CS2 under the matching material defect.
defects.cs3: Impact damage; the resulting defect is recorded in CS3 under the matching material defect.
defects.cs4: Impact damage; the resulting defect is recorded in CS4 under the matching material defect.
